newsitem.title: USA: Fed to stop reporting commercial paper figures.
newsitem.headline: Fed to stop reporting commercial paper figures.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York said on Thursday it will no longer report weekly and monthly commercial paper data after the period ended August 27.
The last report for weekly commercial paper will be issued on September 4, and the last report for monthly commercial paper will be issued at the end of September, a spokeswoman said.
The New York Fed said the decision to stop releasing the data was made by the Fed's Board of Directors.
